content_of_post_to_comment:
Long-time lurker — I've seen many "need an accountability partner" posts in communities like this, and it got me thinking about something I might build.

The idea: an app where you pick a specific challenge you're working on (quitting something(smoking,drinking,fapping etc.), or creating new habbits cutting sugar, no food after a set time, reading, daily exercise, working on your bussiness, whatever it is), then browse and *choose* — not get randomly assigned — a partner working on the exact same thing. You each do a quick daily check-in on whether you stuck to it. No money on the line, just knowing a real person is watching whether you show up, and it goes both ways. If it's not working out, either of you can end the pairing, but you have to say why, and the other person sees it.

Before I build anything, I genuinely want to know if this would help, or if it's solving a problem that doesn't really exist here.

So:
- Have you tried finding an accountability partner for this before? Where, and did it actually work?
- Would you rather be matched with a stranger, or only pair with someone you already know?
- What would make you NOT trust a random person on an app like this?

If this sounds useful, drop a comment and I'll message you when it's ready.

PS: Not trying to sell anything — just trying to figure out if it's worth building. Even "this is a bad idea, here's why" answers are genuinely useful to me.
